mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits phenytoin metabolism via CYP2C9 and displaces phenytoin from protein binding, increasing free phenytoin levels and toxicity risk; phenytoin may increase valproate metabolism.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely (target free level 1-2 mcg/mL), watch for signs of toxicity (ataxia, nystagmus, confusion), and consider phenytoin dose reduction by 20-30% when valproate is added.
